G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: No matching entity on the Texas list of active franchise taxpayers. Texas does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to pay franchise tax, and an exempt entity is left off as well, so this is a check this source cannot complete rather than evidence against the firm. The state's own SOSDirect service can settle it for a fee
G3.source: Active Franchise Taxpayers, published daily as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, partial
G3.unresolvable: Texas lists only active franchise taxpayers, so a firm that is not obliged to be one cannot be found here however often we look

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 28 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2011-11-02, so it has been operating for more than a year

faq.q: How much does The Thompson Law Firm charge?
faq.a: The Thompson Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does The Thompson Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The Thompson Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does The Thompson Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: The Thompson Law Firm publishes one office, in San Antonio. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Thompson Law Firm?
faq.a: The Thompson Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about The Thompson Law Firm?
faq.a: The Thompson Law Firm scores 30 and sits at Listed. Passed: footprint. Did not pass: entity registration and website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
